display.name: Hindsight Health
display.description: Importer and Pi retrieval on the client host; Hindsight API and workers on the service host. All telemetry is content-safe. Metrics refresh every 60 seconds. Missing data is not healthy. Filter Traces and Logs by hindsight-importer, hindsight-retrieval, or hindsight-api for details.

display.name: Importer running
display.description: 1 = running, 0 = stopped or stale heartbeat.

display.name: API healthy
display.description: 1 = healthy, 0 = unhealthy or unavailable.

display.name: Database connected
display.description: 1 = connected, 0 = disconnected or unavailable.

display.name: Current setup issues
display.description: 0 = no current issues. Retained historical failed operations are not included.

display.name: Importer cycle error
display.description: 0 = no current cycle error, 1 = requires attention.

display.name: Desktop feed stale
display.description: 0 = fresh, 1 = stale or unavailable. Only emitted when a desktop feed is enabled.

display.name: Importer queue and failures
display.description: Queued, submitted, processing, failed, and cleanupPending. Settling is not a failure.

display.name: Source coverage
display.description: Scan errors, deferred/settling sessions, unprocessed work, stale sources, and uncertain operations.

display.name: Desktop feed age
display.description: An age above the configured limit is stale. -1 means unavailable.

display.name: Heartbeat age
display.description: 45 seconds or more is stale; -1 means unavailable. No samples when the process stops.

display.name: Documents
display.description: Number of remote Hindsight documents.

display.name: Document hash mismatches
display.description: 0 is expected. Updated after completed import cycles, not each health sample.

display.name: Remote active operations
display.description: Pending and processing operations. Historical terminal failures are excluded.

display.name: Consolidation backlog and failures
display.description: Extracted facts waiting for consolidation and current failed consolidation items.

display.name: Database connection pool
display.description: Current database pool size from the API runtime.

display.name: Database pool waiters
display.description: Callers waiting for a database connection. Sustained growth requires attention.

display.name: Importer and retrieval stage latency
display.description: Average duration. Open Traces to inspect individual slow operations.

display.name: HTTP retries
display.description: Retries per second by transport, HTTP response, or token refresh.

display.name: Generation results
display.description: Completed, failed, or deferred generations per second.

display.name: Memory search results
display.description: Searches per second. Degraded means local fallback or unavailable local data.

display.name: Server operation latency
display.description: Native operation durations; only populated when operations run.

display.name: LLM latency
display.description: Native LLM latency without prompts or completions.

display.name: LLM input tokens
display.description: Input tokens per second during extraction or consolidation; no data during idle periods.

display.name: LLM output tokens
display.description: Output tokens per second during extraction or consolidation; no data during idle periods.

display.name: Importer / retrieval RSS
display.description: Resident memory of the Node process. Retrieval runs in the Pi process.

display.name: Server peak RSS
display.description: Native server rss_max: peak resident memory since process start.

display.name: Importer CPU time rate
display.description: CPU seconds per second by user and system mode.

display.name: Importer state disk available
display.description: Free space on the state filesystem.

display.name: Failed export batches
display.description: Failed batches per second by service and signal. A zero rate is normal.

display.name: Exporter last success age
display.description: Age of the last successful export. Idle signals can have an older sample; no-data rules monitor the always-on metric heartbeat.

display.name: Importer queue wait
display.description: Mean time from queue admission to the first worker attempt. Does not include session settling or execution.

display.title: Current health — 60-second samples; missing data is not healthy
Queue, source coverage, and data integrity
Performance and errors — idle services can have no work samples
